data.name: Emanuele
data.gender_notes: Emanuele is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name Emmanuel, which means 'God is with us'. In the Bible, this name is given to Jesus, the Messiah, in the Old Testament book of Isaiah. The name Emanuele carries the meaning “God with us” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Emanuele usually hope their child will grow to embody god with us and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the presence and guidance of God in one's life.
data.etymology: Emanuele belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God with us.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Emanuele total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_hebrew.name: עמנואל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: עמנואל הוא שם עברי שפירושו 'אלוהים הוא עמנו'. הוא מורכב משתי מילים: 'עמנו' שפירושו 'עמנו' ו-'אל' שפירושו 'אלוהים'. השם עמנואל מוזכר בספר ישעיהו, פרק ז', פסוק 14, ומתייחס לנבואה על בואו של ישו המשיח.

in_greek.name: Εμμανουήλ
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εμμανουήλ είναι ελληνική μορφή του εβραϊκού ονόματος עמנואל, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός είναι μαζί μας'. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Εμμανουήλ αναφέρεται στο κατά Ματθαίον Ευαγγέλιον, κεφάλαιο 1, εδάφιο 23, ως προφητεία για την έλευση του Ιησού Χριστού.

in_latin.name: Emanuele
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Emanuele derivatur ex hebraeo nomine עמנואל, quod significat 'Deus nobiscum'. In Ecclesia primitiva, nomen Emanuele considerabatur propheticum, praenuntians adventum Iesu Christi, qui est Deus nobiscum.

in_english.name: Emanuele
in_english.long_meaning: The name Emanuele originates from the Hebrew name עמנואל (Immanuel), meaning 'God is with us'. It is a significant name in Christianity, referencing Isaiah 7:14 and Matthew 1:23, which prophesize the coming of Jesus Christ as God with us. Emanuele symbolizes divine presence, spiritual guidance, and the bond between God and humanity.

data.cultural_impact: The name Emanuele is popular in many Christian communities around the world, and is a common name in Italy and other European countries. It carries a rich cultural history, and is reminiscent of the celebration and respect for the birth of Jesus, who is referred to as Emmanuel. For families who hold this name dear, it represents their deep connection and faith in their Christian beliefs.
data.spiritual_significance: Named by the Virgin Mary and an angel in the Bible, Emanuele is a powerful reminder of God's presence with us. For those who bear this name, it carries a deep spiritual significance, a constant reminder of the divine love and companionship that God offers. It also serves as a reminder of the importance of faith and trust in God during difficult times.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Emanuele carries the meaning of "God with us". It is a reminder of the promise of God's presence and guidance in our lives. Emmanuel, the name from which Emanuele originates, was given to Jesus in Isaiah 7:14 as a sign of the divine presence among God's people.

biblical_reference.note: Prophecy about Jesus Christ as Immanuel

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Emanuele is mentioned in the writings of Saint Augustine The name Emanuele carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Emanuele is associated with the early Christian Church in North Africa

trends: Italian name gaining popularity in the US
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Emanuele remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: A devoted Christian named John Emanuele in Jerusalem, Israel credits much of their spiritual journey to their name Emanuele, which means "God with us". They believe their name has been a blessing and reminder of God's presence in their life.
